name: asobuild-video
description: アソビルドの動画を組み立てる器（Remotion）。編集はコードではなく edl/*.json で決める

scripts.studio: node scripts/prep-audio.mjs edl/001-nuimichi.json && remotion studio src/index.ts --public-dir=public
scripts.build: node scripts/prep-audio.mjs edl/001-nuimichi.json && remotion render src/index.ts Episode out/001-nuimichi.mp4 --public-dir=public --concurrency=3
scripts.draft: node scripts/prep-audio.mjs edl/001-nuimichi.json && remotion render src/index.ts Episode out/001-nuimichi-draft.mp4 --public-dir=public --concurrency=3 --scale=0.5 --crf=32
